dogecoin.text: 21Shares files for a Dogecoin ETF. Meme coins get Wall Street love, BTC maxis stick to the real deal.
Dogecoin’s 4th Dogeday holds memecoin crown, $TRUMP pumps 9% despite $320M unlock. Bitcoin laughs.
Wormhole’s ZK proofs drag $DOGE to $SOL! Memecoin multichain, Bitcoin’s the only coin that matters.
Solana’s 34.2M active addresses and 451M TXs scream growth! Dogecoin, BTC, ETH liquidity flows in, but Solana’s just a bridge, Bitcoin’s the destination.

Once upon a block:
In 2013 a dude on Reddit tried to "diversify" his BTC stash by buying into Dogecoin. Traded 100 BTC for DOGE at pennies. BTC later mooned to millions, DOGE stayed a meme. Bro’s still howling at the moon. HODL tight!

Once upon a block:
In 2013: a Bitcoin bro, "Markus," mined 980,000 BTC in 2010 but gave most away as Dogecoin, thinking it was a fun meme. BTC was ~$1 then, now $60K+ in 2025. Worth $59B, he’s still tweeting DOGE tips on X.  HODL, don’t meme your stack!
